title: Sensor timing for the Omega Game Sphere AR engine
description: A design brief for the Omega Game Sphere augmented reality engine in the OneiroNexus project. It explains why the engine needs a timing budget for sensor observations and proposes a comparison of timestamp accuracy, drift, delivery delay and event ordering against a conventional baseline. It identifies the Colorado Quantum Incubator's public Quantum Timing Testbed as the proposed timing evaluation site. The brief records the proposed work.
